title: wavecoord consumer config
description: The git-tracked file .claude/wavecoord.json in a consumer repo. It holds no secrets. See docs/adapters.md.

adapter.description: builtin: plan/tasks; commands: your own tooling; specs: the spec tree (docs/specs.md). Without a plan key, the spec tree is used when spec.dir has records on the default branch

ssh.description: ssh destination (user@host or an ssh config alias); null or absent means local

providers.description: Provider profiles this host has; absent means every configured profile

labels.description: Capabilities of the host, matched against exec.host_needs (with the host name)

dispatch.description: false: automatic placement (dispatch, dispatch_wave, the dispatcher, launch without --host) never picks this host; an explicit host (--host, dispatch host) still does

providers.description: Provider profiles for workers (docs/providers.md). The secrets live in env_file on each host, never here.

env_file.description: Path on the host to a mode-600 KEY=VALUE file

cost_basis.description: What total_cost_usd means for this profile (default anthropic_estimate)

pr_state_cmd.description: Prints JSON with state (OPEN, MERGED, CLOSED) and mergedAt of an attempt PR; default gh pr view {pr} --json state,mergedAt

fence.description: The edit fence (docs/design/edit-fence.md, section 8). A mode word sets every point; an object sets each point. Each point is off, advisory (warn only; the default) or enforce. lead is the action for a lead or other session on a foreign exclusive path (default ask). Only the copy on the default branch counts; a worktree copy can only make the fence stricter.

auto_resolve.description: On a merge-tree conflict, the collector dispatches a resolver attempt by itself

auto_steer.description: What triage does with a stuck worker: off (nothing), draft (the steerer drafts a hint for the lead), hints (triage sends plain-text hints itself)

dir.description: The spec directory, relative to the repo root (default specs)

require_approved.description: A task is ready only when its requirement is approved and its ancestors are active

suspect.description: refuse: a task whose requirement changed since its basis is not ready

verify_at_merge.description: The refinery runs the task's Acceptance and its requirement's Verify, from the default branch, before a merge

status_commits.description: The coordinator writes task status into the spec tree

status_flush_s.description: Seconds between status commits (a merge flushes at once)

cmd.description: A command, run without a shell when it is an array; as a shell string otherwise.
